parameters.query:
WITH entrada AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    NULLIF(BTRIM($1::text), ''),
    TO_CHAR(date_trunc('month', timezone('America/Sao_Paulo', now())), 'YYYY-MM')
  ) AS competencia_texto
), periodo AS (
  SELECT competencia_texto,
    CASE WHEN competencia_texto ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$'
      THEN to_date(competencia_texto || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS competencia
  FROM entrada
)
SELECT
  p.competencia_texto AS competencia_solicitada,
  CASE WHEN p.competencia IS NULL THEN 'Competencia invalida. Use AAAA-MM.' END AS erro_consulta,
  i.*
FROM periodo p
LEFT JOIN public.pacto_indicadores_mensais i ON i.competencia = p.competencia
ORDER BY i.unidade_codigo;
